training_examples.solution:
def reverse_linked_list(head):
    prev = None
    current = head
    while current:
        next_node = current.next
        current.next = prev
        prev = current
        current = next_node
    return prev
training_examples.explanation: Iteratively reverse pointers by maintaining three pointers: previous, current, and next
Dynamic programming solution building 2D table where dp[i][j] represents LCS length of first i characters of text1 and first j characters of text2

training_examples.problem: Implement depth-first search on binary tree
training_examples.solution:
def dfs_inorder(root):
    if not root:
        return []
    result = []
    result.extend(dfs_inorder(root.left))
    result.append(root.val)
    result.extend(dfs_inorder(root.right))
    return result
training_examples.explanation: Recursive in-order traversal: visit left subtree, current node, then right subtree
training_examples.space_complexity: O(h) where h is tree height
